::: {.home-section .home-about}
::: {.home-section__heading}
[About]{.home-section__kicker}

## Methods, software, and real-world public health
:::

::: {.home-about__grid}
::: {.home-about__copy}
I am an Associate Research Professor in the [Division of Epidemiology at the University of Utah](https://medicine.utah.edu/internalmedicine/epidemiology/){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}, with adjunct appointments in Population Health Sciences and the Kahlert School of Computing. My work uses statistical computing to study complex systems, especially problems in network science and computational epidemiology.

For more than a decade, I have translated demanding research questions into reliable software for high-performance computing, data visualization, social network analysis, and agent-based modeling. I also integrate modern AI and agentic workflows where they make research and software development more rigorous, efficient, and useful.
:::

::: {.home-credentials}
### Interdisciplinary training

- **Ph.D., Biostatistics** — University of Southern California, 2020
- **M.Sc., Economics** — California Institute of Technology, 2015
- **M.A., Public Policy** — Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez, 2011
